versions.content: Dependencies of software and configuration data. Type: draft Description: FOTA Target ECU shall support mechanisms to resolve potential incompatibilities between different software revisions and corresponding configuration data. Rationale: Software and configuration data shall be in line to each other. Dependencies: Use Case: In case of a FOTA update, configuration data (variant information, learnt values, offsets, etc.) is to be handled properly. In case configuration data shall be adapted after installation of a new software revision, the corresponding mechanisms, either FOTA Target ECU internal or with involvement of the FOTA Master ECU, are provided. Supporting Material:
